resources.string: FocusGuard uses Accessibility to help you stay focused. It detects which app is in the foreground to block the apps you chose and enforce your schedules and time limits. It reads on-screen text such as browser address bars, search boxes and YouTube titles only to match your blocked keywords, Shorts/Reels and adult-content filters. This text is processed on your device and is not uploaded. It can press Back or Home and show a full-screen overlay to close blocked content. If you turn on uninstall protection, it also detects when someone opens FocusGuard\'s uninstall or Device Admin screens.
